# `jouet wind claim`

- **Usage:** `jouet wind claim [--root <PATH>] [--idle <IDLE>] <SNAPSHOT>`

Claim one planned snapshot for review

## Arguments
- **`<SNAPSHOT>`** — Snapshot ID from `jouet wind plan`

## Flags
- **`--root <PATH>`** — Directory containing opted-in projects; repeat as in the plan
- **`--idle <IDLE>`** — The same idle threshold used by the plan (default 15m)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
